results.q: What is the difference between moral responsibility and legal resnposibility. Give example.
results.answer: Moral responsibility tends to be shared among many individuals, whereas causal, role, and legal responsibilities tend to be exclusive [1]. Legal responsibility involves being charged with a crime or being liable for damages in a civil lawsuit, such as a physician being sued for malpractice or a manufacturer being found liable under strict liability even if the product met safety standards [3]. An example of moral responsibility is when a software tester is held responsible for harms caused by outages despite not intending them, or when a hacker is responsible for attempting to invade privacy even if their program fails [2]. An example of legal responsibility is when AECL could have been sued in the Therac-25 case for damages resulting from the radiation treatment machine [3].
